### `uniformEmptyMessage`

Zero results after ACL filtering is ambiguous — nothing matched, or nothing was permitted. The user-facing message must not distinguish them, or the assistant becomes an oracle for "does repo X exist" (§15.7 on the external assistant, but the same applies internally to confidential repos).

```typescript
uniformEmptyMessage(): string
```

**Returns** `string`

<sub>[Source](https://github.com/nmsanka/kna/blob/486c61286bfa1cd2cadabe6b53585202c2e154ce/packages/retrieval/src/acl.ts#L136)</sub>
